title: Dividend Option Service Terms: Placing the Anniversary Dividend on Deposit Under the Whole Life Insurance Accumulate Option
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — Ashgrove participating tiers.

## Terms

Under the accumulate option, the dividend declared on a policy anniversary is placed on deposit with Ashgrove as one dividend deposit entry dated that anniversary for the policy year the dividend is paid for.

A dividend is placed on deposit at an anniversary only after the interest credit for the policy year that anniversary closes stands on the accumulation ledger.

Equivalently: as long as the accumulation ledger shows no interest credit for the policy year that anniversary closes, no dividend is placed on deposit at that anniversary.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Option | Accumulate at interest |
| Entry | One dividend deposit entry dated the anniversary, for the policy year the dividend is paid for |
| Accumulation balance | Raised by exactly the amount placed on deposit; nothing is paid to the owner |

## Invocation: `deposit_anniversary_dividend_704bd37e`

**Capability.** Places the anniversary dividend of one Ashgrove whole life policy on deposit with Ashgrove under the accumulate-at-interest dividend option. One call books a single dividend deposit entry dated the anniversary for the policy year given and raises the policy's dividend accumulation balance by exactly the deposit amount given; nothing is paid to the owner.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the whole life policy whose dividend is placed on deposit, as returned by the whole life policy lookup for the verified owner | Identifier, as recorded |
| `anniversary_date` | The policy anniversary on which the dividend was declared; it becomes the date of the entry | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `dividend_year` | The policy year the dividend is paid for | An integer policy year counted from the issue date |
| `deposit_amount` | The amount placed on deposit | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `deposit_id` (the reference of the new deposit entry), `whole_policy_id`, `dividend_year` (integer policy year), `amount_deposited` (2 decimal places) and `accumulation_balance_after` (the deposit balance including this dividend, 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying a `deposit_id` means the deposit was booked.
